decal_keepouts.note: Learned from owner's in-game wireframe renders (Mountain Dew v1, 2026-07-13). The FRONT FENDER FLARE piece overlays the door strip's forward end in 3D — side decals extending past the boundary get chopped mid-glyph on the car. Also: iRacing stamps the WoO series decal over the sail boards; sponsor art there is wasted (put quarter-panel sponsors on the BAND upper-rear instead). Roof: official Number Blocks guide is LANDSCAPE (339x246) -> roof art reads front/rear, and the real-paint corpus (reads at rot0) maps to reads-from-REAR in game; that is the real DLM convention, keep it.
decal_keepouts.sail_boards: series decal overlay — no sponsor placement
decal_keepouts.dark_field_logos: logos must contrast the destination field: use white knockout versions of dark wordmarks on DEW-green-class fields

mined_orientation._method: OCR-at-4-rotations vote across 50 real DLM paints (dirtlatemodel 350, 757 available) + structure-tensor stripe angles. Controls right_door(rot0)/left_door(rot180) reproduced with 30/34 clear wins — method validated. _dlm_orientation_miner.py / _dlm_orientation_report.py, 2026-07-13.
mined_orientation.fender_stripe_flow: both fender pieces: continuation bands rise up-right ~+37 deg in template space, entering from the lower door-side edge (mined angle left 37/coh .66 + corpus examples car_1147215, car_817663)
mined_orientation.topleft_pieces: both read rot0 with text present — likely nose cone halves / tail; identity still unconfirmed
